title: coordinate-ttl-jitter-and-compact-stream-facade-across-sdks
author: Leah Park
description:
Motivation: Several downstream customers reported spillover retry storms when auth TTLs expired concurrently and stream reconnects spiked. This PR harmonizes SDK behaviors for auth prefetch and backoff windows, introduces a small randomized jitter to retry windows to smooth bursts, and simultaneously adds a compact streaming facade with unified async/pullstream ergonomics for Python, TypeScript, and Go. The goal is parity of observable behavior across SDKs while keeping surface area minimal.

What this PR does (summary):
- Introduces a jittered retry-window helper used by all three SDKs. The default is a +-10% jitter around configured retry windows; jitter is deterministic when TEST_JITTER_SEED is set for unit tests.
- Adds TTL-prefetch hooks for token providers so SDKs start background refreshes earlier for long-running streams. Prefetch timing is configurable per-sdk.
- Implements a compact stream facade across sdks (py: AsyncPullStream, ts: compactPullStream, go: PullStreamIterator) that normalizes: end-of-stream signaling, error propagation, and graceful cancellation.
- Fixes parity bugs found during integration: TS previously emitted a final empty chunk on EOS; Go canceled contexts without draining causal telemetry; Python edge cases where background prefetch raced with close() are handled.
- Bumps versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 2.8.0, go v0.9.1 and updates CHANGELOG entries.
- Adds examples, unit and integration tests, and small docs updates for the retry config and streaming facade.

Checklist: [x] Cross-SDK sync design doc linked, [x] Unit tests (py/ts/go), [x] Integration tests for streaming, [x] Docs update, [x] Changelogs updated, [x] Version bumps.

Compatibility notes: Defaults keep previous behavior (jitter is small and enabled by default); customers can opt out via SDK config. No API surface breaking changes were introduced; changes are additive and opt-out capable.

Implementation notes (single-string): Core logic is in a tiny shared design spec and then implemented separately in each SDK to avoid a new shared binary dependency. Python: session.py gets TokenPrefetcher and jitter helper; AsyncPullStream sits in sdks/python/redwood/streams.py exposing async iterator + close()/aiter semantics. TypeScript: compactPullStream facade in src/stream/compact.ts plus a Jitter module and updated token-provider hooks. Go: PullStreamIterator and token prefetcher added under stream/iterator.go and auth/prefetch.go. Tests added to each sdks' test suites and CI matrix updated to run cross-sdk streaming integration.

Related: ENG-4128 (auth storms), SUP-88 (customer incident follow-up), ENG-4199 (streaming ergonomics initiative)

review_comments: Miguel Soto: Nice consolidation. Two asks: (1) make jitter deterministic in tests (seedable) so CI flakes disappear, (2) ensure the default prefetch window doesn't trigger extra token calls in short-lived sessions.
Leah Park (author): Added TEST_JITTER_SEED env var to each SDK and updated unit tests to set it. Prefetch default reduced to 15% of TTL for short-lived sessions with config override.

Rina Patel: TS type nit — compactPullStream should expose a typed Done error shape; left an inline comment in src/stream/compact.ts. Also request: add a small example demonstrating how to opt-out of jitter.
Leah Park: Addressed TS type comment and added opt-out example in examples/streaming/prefetch-example.md
Tom Becker: CI caught an integration failure on the first run (stream reconnection flake). After adding the jitter seeding the integration tests passed. Approving once CI green.
Miguel Soto: Approving. Leaving a note: observe latency metrics for 24 hours post-merge to confirm smoothing effect.
ci_checks: integration-tests: fail -> rerun -> pass (flaky stream reconnect fixed by seeded jitter)
merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge by Rina Patel after approvals. Commit message condensed to: 'sdk: harmonize ttl prefetch + jittered retry window; add compact streaming facade across Python/TypeScript/Go; bump SDK versions.'
release_notes: Cross-SDK: smoother retry/backoff behavior with small default jitter to reduce concurrent reconnect storms; new compact streaming facade (AsyncPullStream/compactPullStream/PullStreamIterator) to normalize stream ergonomics across SDKs; token prefetch hooks for long-running streams; patch-version bumps (py 1.12.0, ts 2.8.0, go v0.9.1). Opt-out flags available in each SDK's config.
notes_for_ops: Monitor sdk.stream.reconnect.rate and sdk.auth.refresh.calls for the next 48 hours. If reconnect rate drops but refresh.calls spike, consider raising prefetch threshold. A CI env var TEST_JITTER_SEED was added for deterministic tests.
